name: v26.3-2
body:
## What's Changed
* Add **CushionHop** - lets you ride cushions by automatically moving between them with WASD, featuring auto-pathing, rotation, and configurable hop timing
> *P.S. I noticed TrouserStreak beat me to a similar module release. However, CushionHop serves a different purpose: it navigates existing cushion setups rather than automating their placement*
* Update Catppuccin theme addon to v2.4.0

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Zgoly/Meteorist/compare/v26.3-1...v26.3-2
